verdict.rationale: Maritime hosts and runs AI agents, so letting those agents connect to MCP servers as clients is a fair axis for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP client support or configuring external MCP servers. The closest items are Docker framework images, Telegram/WhatsApp/Google channels, and a CLI that other agents can operate, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
